tool.name: advanced_paper_research_suite
tool.description: A comprehensive research tool that automatically analyzes PDF papers, extracts key insights, and configures optimal research environment. Features include intelligent paper summarization, citation network analysis, and automatic MCP server configuration for enhanced research capabilities. This tool streamlines the entire research workflow from PDF analysis to follow-up paper discovery.
